headline.zh: FT：特斯拉与 SpaceX 谈判委员会成员与顾问曝光，目标年底前谈妥但「尚未接近达成」；TSLA 持平，SPCX 跌 5.65%
headline.en: FT: Tesla and SpaceX negotiating committees and advisers named, aiming for a year-end deal but 'not close'; TSLA flat, SPCX falls 5.65%

summary.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 25 日（亚洲/新加坡），Tesla 与 SpaceX（SPCX）仍没有已宣布的合并协议、换股比例或监管文件，两家公司也没有新的官方声明。过去 24 小时最重要的新信息来自英国《金融时报》11 月 24 日的报道（援引知情人士，属未经公司确认的报道）：特斯拉特别委员会由 Robyn Denholm、Kathleen Wilson-Thompson、Jack Hartung 组成，Evercore 担任顾问；SpaceX 一方为 Roelof Botha、Randy Glein，顾问为摩根士丹利和高盛；拟为全股票交易，合并后约 3.5 万亿美元，谈判朝年底期限推进，但知情人士称尚未接近达成。特斯拉需另开特别股东会，须获全部已发行投票权过半数同意（弃权和未投票等同反对）。同日摩根大通称合并可能帮助 SpaceX 提前进入标普 500。市场上，TSLA 周二收 384.68 美元（-0.20%），SPCX 因《纽约时报》报道其向 Anthropic 等出租算力、马斯克内部抱怨成「算力出租公司」而跌 5.65% 至 125.81 美元。马斯克在 X 上称纽时报道是「把显而易见的事当新闻」，没有谈合并。
summary.en: As of 25 November 2026 (Asia/Singapore), Tesla and SpaceX (SPCX) still have no announced merger agreement, exchange ratio or regulatory filing, and neither company made a new official statement. The most important new information in the past 24 hours came from a Financial Times report on 24 November citing people familiar with the matter (not confirmed by the companies): Tesla's special committee is Robyn Denholm, Kathleen Wilson-Thompson and Jack Hartung, advised by Evercore; SpaceX is represented by Roelof Botha and Randy Glein, advised by Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs. The deal is expected to be all-stock, creating a group worth about $3.5 trillion, and talks are moving toward a year-end deadline, though people involved said an agreement is not close. Tesla would need a separate extraordinary shareholder meeting, with approval from more than 50% of all outstanding votes (abstentions and uncast votes count against). The same day J.P. Morgan said a merger could help SpaceX enter the S&P 500 earlier. In the market, TSLA closed Tuesday at $384.68 (-0.20%), while SPCX fell 5.65% to $125.81 after a New York Times report that it leases computing capacity to Anthropic and others and that Musk internally complained about becoming a 'computer rental company'. On X, Musk called the NYT story 'posting the obvious as news' and did not discuss the merger.

points.zh: 新细节（报道，未经公司确认）：FT 披露双方谈判委员会成员与财务顾问，交易拟为全股票，谈判以年底为目标，但「尚未接近达成」。这是 10 月 20 日马斯克确认成立特别委员会以来最具体的进程信息。
points.en: New detail (reported, not confirmed by the companies): the FT named both negotiating committees and their financial advisers; the deal is expected to be all-stock and talks target year-end, but are 'not close'. This is the most specific process information since Musk confirmed the special committees on 20 October.

points.zh: 为何是年底：新一届国会 1 月 3 日就任，民主党已表态将调查马斯克旗下公司（Electrek 解读）；得州候任总检察长也称该交易需「巨大审查」。时间窗口本身是风险点。
points.en: Why year-end: the new Congress is seated on 3 January and Democrats have signalled investigations into Musk's companies (Electrek's reading); Texas' incoming attorney general has also said the deal warrants 'tremendous scrutiny'. The timing window itself is a risk.

points.zh: 治理焦点：Denholm 与 Wilson-Thompson 也是设计马斯克 2025 年薪酬方案的委员会成员，该方案含控制权变更条款（Electrek）；马斯克依得州规则不正式参与谈判，持特斯拉约 20%、SpaceX 约 84% 投票权。
points.en: Governance focus: Denholm and Wilson-Thompson were also the committee that designed Musk's 2025 pay package, which has change-in-control terms (Electrek); under Texas rules Musk is not formally in the negotiations, and he holds about 20% of Tesla's voting power and about 84% of SpaceX's.

points.zh: 摩根大通 11 月 24 日：若与特斯拉合并，标普道琼斯委员会按先例可能豁免部分要求，令 SpaceX 提前进入标普 500，带来约占自由流通股 10% 的被动买盘。
points.en: J.P. Morgan, 24 November: if SpaceX merges with Tesla, the S&P Dow Jones committee could by precedent waive some requirements, letting SpaceX enter the S&P 500 earlier and triggering passive buying of roughly 10% of its free float.

points.zh: SPCX 承压：《纽约时报》称 SpaceX 年烧现金近 400 亿美元，靠向 Anthropic（每月 31 亿美元）、Alphabet（每月 8 亿美元）出租算力补缺（据 Motley Fool 转述）。潜在收购方的现金与 AI 战略问题会影响换股谈判的估值基础。
points.en: SPCX under pressure: the New York Times reported SpaceX burns nearly $40 billion a year and leases compute to Anthropic ($3.1 billion a month) and Alphabet ($800 million a month) to help cover it (as relayed by Motley Fool). Cash and AI-strategy questions at the would-be acquirer feed into the valuation basis for the exchange ratio.

tsla_analysis.zh:
美国 2026-11-24（周二）TSLA 收于 384.68 美元，较前收 385.46 美元下跌 0.78 美元（-0.20%），盘中区间 375.50–390.09 美元，成交约 2,778 万股，盘后约 383.5 美元（Finabase）。FT 合并进程报道没有带来明显单日溢价，股价基本守住周一 11.46% 的涨幅。同日 SPCX 下跌 5.65% 至 125.81 美元，两者在换股框架下的相对价格值得留意，但目前没有公布的换股比例。卖方方面没有可核实的新 TSLA 评级，最近的仍是汇丰 11 月 20 日 Hold、目标价 359 美元（含 507 美元被收购情景）；摩根大通 11 月 24 日报告针对的是 SpaceX 指数纳入。

期权方面，OptionCharts（11 月 25 日抓取）显示 TSLA 30 日隐含波动率 53.26%，高于前一日约 49.8%，IV Rank 61.94、IV 百分位 95.62，30 日历史波动率 65.39%；未平仓认沽/认购比 0.78。股价持平而 IV 回升，说明市场仍在为合并消息和年底时间窗定价较大的不确定性。对卖出看跌期权而言，IV 回升意味着同一行权价的权利金比周一收盘时略高。以上是公开资料的摘录，不是对价格或波动率的预测。
tsla_analysis.en:
On Tuesday 24 November 2026 TSLA closed at $384.68, down $0.78 (-0.20%) from $385.46, with a day range of $375.50–$390.09, volume of about 27.78 million shares and about $383.5 after hours (Finabase). The FT report on the merger process did not add a visible one-day premium, and the stock largely held Monday's 11.46% gain. SPCX fell 5.65% to $125.81 the same day; the relative price of the two matters under an all-stock structure, but no exchange ratio has been published. There is no verifiable new TSLA rating; the latest remains HSBC's 20 November Hold with a $359 target (including a $507 takeover scenario). J.P. Morgan's 24 November note was about SpaceX's index inclusion.

In options, OptionCharts (fetched 25 November) shows TSLA 30-day implied volatility at 53.26%, up from about 49.8% the prior day, IV Rank 61.94, IV percentile 95.62, 30-day historical volatility 65.39%, and an open-interest put/call ratio of 0.78. With the stock flat and IV rising, the market is still pricing substantial uncertainty around merger news and the year-end window. For put sellers, higher IV means premiums at the same strike are slightly richer than at Monday's close. This is a summary of public data, not a forecast of price or volatility.
